Markets.title: US bull market nears fourth anniversary, but narrow rally raises risks
Markets.summary: The US stock bull market is approaching its fourth anniversary, supported by strong corporate earnings and low volatility. However, heavy reliance on artificial intelligence and a narrow rally create risks for the broader market if sentiment shifts.

Markets.title: Anthem Biosciences block deal: Portsmouth Technologies sells 30 lakh shares worth Rs 250 crore
Markets.summary: Portsmouth Technologies sold 30 lakh shares of Anthem Biosciences in a block deal on October 9 for Rs 249.90 crore. The transaction significantly decreases Portsmouth's stake in the company following its recent decline in quarterly income and profit.

Markets.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 profit surges fivefold as income rises
Markets.summary: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a fivefold increase in net profit for the second quarter, driven by higher net interest and fee income. The growth was further supported by new loan products and improved gross non-performing asset figures.

Markets.title: Rupee recovers to 96.73 vs US dollar after RBI intervention, but dollar demand persists
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee recovered slightly to 96.73 against the US dollar following heavy intervention by the Reserve Bank of India. However, the currency remains weighed down by persistent corporate dollar demand, a 7% year-to-date decline, and falling forex reserves.

Markets.title: US stocks: US market rises as oil retreats; SpaceX spectrum deal hammers telecoms
Markets.summary: US stocks rose at the opening bell as falling oil prices eased concerns about Middle Eastern supply disruptions. Meanwhile, telecom shares declined due to competitive anxiety following a spectrum purchase by SpaceX.

Markets.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Results: Profit skyrockets 407% YoY to Rs 375 crore, NII rises 81%
Markets.summary: Poonawalla Fincorp reported a 407% year-on-year surge in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 375 crore. The company's financial growth was driven by an 81% increase in net interest income, improving asset quality, and an expanded gold loan network.

Geo-Political.title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
Geo-Political.summary: Former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay has won the Nobel Peace Prize. The Norwegian Nobel Committee recognized her for her efforts to promote peace and international law.

Geo-Political.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
Geo-Political.summary: Pete Hegseth announced that a military firing squad execution will be livestreamed to the public. A legal expert stated that this unprecedented decision faces uncertain legal ground.

Geo-Political.title: Fort Hood survivor supports gunman's execution by firing squad but questions livestream
Geo-Political.summary: Alonzo Lunsford, a survivor of the Fort Hood shooting, supports the gunman's execution by firing squad because the punishment fits the crime. However, he questions whether the public should be allowed to watch the execution via livestream.

Geo-Political.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condems as 'assault on rule of law'
Geo-Political.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, prompting the court to condemn the action as an assault on the rule of law. The European Union also criticized the U.S. move, describing it as deeply regrettable.

Geo-Political.title: Thieves steal 30,000 bottles of wine worth €5m in Italy, reports say
Geo-Political.summary: Thieves stole 30,000 bottles of wine valued at €5 million from a winery in Florence, Italy. Authorities believe this is one of the largest wine thefts in the country's history.

Geo-Political.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
Geo-Political.summary: A left-wing candidate named Hitler Mussolini won a narrow mayoral victory in a remote district of the Peruvian Andes. Exit polls confirmed the election results in the region.

Data & Insights.title: EU-China trade breakthrough: Beijing agrees to moderate hybrid car exports by more than half | Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: China agreed to reduce its hybrid car exports to the European Union by more than half. The deal aims to ease growing trade tensions between Beijing and the bloc.

Data & Insights.title: Mint explainer: how will the  ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund (SGF) help Indian MSMEs?
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is launching a ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund to provide equity capital to small and medium businesses. This funding will help MSMEs expand capacity, adopt new technology, and compete in the global market.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council Meeting Oct 2026: List of decisions taken - arrest, prosecution, general penalty and more
Data & Insights.summary: The October 2026 GST Council meeting removed arrest powers for officers and raised the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore. Additional reforms included reduced penalties, faster refunds, and simplified registration processes.

Data & Insights.title: Homecooked food gets expensive, vegetarians to pay more than non-vegetarians amid onion, rice, LPG price hike: Crisil
Data & Insights.summary: In September 2026, the cost of a home-cooked vegetarian thali rose to ₹30.8 from ₹28.1 the previous year. Meanwhile, a non-vegetarian thali increased to ₹59.5 from ₹56 due to rising prices for onions, rice, and LPG.

Data & Insights.title: India signs pact to address global excess capacity: What is it? Who are the 15 signatories? Check joint statement
Data & Insights.summary: India and 14 other economies signed a pact to address and take action against policies that cause global excess manufacturing capacity and distort markets. The signatories agreed to share information and develop coordinated responses to these issues.

India.title: Ahead Of CJP's Protest, 200 Social Media Takedown Orders Issued
India.summary: Indian police have issued 200 social media takedown orders to monitor online content related to a campaign targeting Gyanesh Kumar. This action precedes a planned protest organized by the CJP.

India.title: Delhi Police Issues Traffic Advisory Ahead Of CJP Protest: Check Affected Routes
India.summary: Delhi Police announced traffic diversions at 30 key points and the closure of 57 metro stations for entry and exit on October 10. These disruptions are expected ahead of a planned protest by the CJP.

India.title: 'President Sought Vote Theft Proof. We Are Ready With It': Rahul Gandhi After Meeting
India.summary: Following a meeting of 150 INDIA bloc MPs, leaders from 16 different parties signed a memorandum to submit to the President. Rahul Gandhi stated they are prepared to provide the proof of vote theft requested by the President.

India.title: Ahead Of CJP Protest, Internet To Be Cut For 24 Hours Around Jantar Mantar
India.summary: Delhi Police ordered a 24-hour internet shutdown around Jantar Mantar. The restriction is ahead of a scheduled protest regarding the CJP.

India.title: Can't Be Complete Prohibition On Delhi Metro, Trains: Top Court On CJP Protests
India.summary: The Supreme Court told the Centre that a complete prohibition on Delhi Metro and train services cannot be implemented due to commuter concerns. The court asked the government to reconsider travel restrictions because people travel from all parts of the city.

India.title: Delhi Protests Live Updates: Opposition Leaders Meet President Droupadi Murmu
India.summary: Opposition leaders in India met with President Droupadi Murmu in Delhi. The meeting preceded a protest organized by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) against the chief of the election commission.

General.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condems as 'assault on rule of law'
General.summary: The United States has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court. The European Union condemned the decision as an assault on the rule of law.

General.title: Polanski vows to stay on as Green leader as he faces criticism after by-election defeat
General.summary: Green Party leader Zack Polanski has vowed to remain in his position despite facing criticism and calls for his resignation. The backlash follows a recent by-election defeat and a controversy involving Zionism.

General.title: King pays Andrew's £1.5m repair bill on Royal Lodge
General.summary: King Charles paid £1.5 million in repair and restoration costs for the Royal Lodge mansion. The bill was charged to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor after he surrendered the lease on the 30-room property.

General.title: Widdecombe suspect had 'particular hostility to Reform', court told
General.summary: A suspect named Kerry is charged with the murder of 78-year-old former Conservative minister and Reform UK spokeswoman Ann Widdecombe. A court was told that the suspect had a particular hostility toward the Reform party.

General.title: Lib Dem MP quits frontbench job over Ed Davey's leadership
General.summary: Deputy party leader Daisy Cooper says "the vast majority of our MPs support Ed... and are furious at this distraction."

General.title: Anthropic bans users from being 'cruel' to its AI systems
General.summary: The firm said users can no longer engage in "sustained and needless" abusive behaviour towards the tech.
